problem: Closing or destroying scene output during color selection still applied the returned background color.
change: Check Qt validity, visibility and owner lifetime before opening the color picker and before applying its result.

reproduction.observed: Background changed from black to magenta after reject, close and destruction.

coverage: Closed or destroyed dialogs preserve the previous background and refuse to reopen the picker.
Cancelling preserves black; reopening and retrying applies magenta.
The real renderer and FrameSender produce RGB [255, 0, 255] at the transparent background pixel, observed by a local camera substitute.
Reject stops the output timer, closes the render session and drains the local camera sender.

limitations: Offscreen Qt with substituted color dialog returns and camera device; no physical camera was opened.
Full regression, independent review and integration remain pending. Native checks do not cover OS keyboard input or a real color picker.

native.platform: Windows private desktop, Traditional_Chinese, dark, 900x740 main window
native.entry: Actual scene page open_output entry; widget-local Tab/Space operates preview and color buttons. Color returns are substituted.
